text: Create each photo report in a new empty output folder outside the input directory. This keeps generated thumbnails out of later image scans and preserves previous review reports. Originals are opened for analysis and never overwritten. If a report folder already contains files, choose a different folder rather than deleting an earlier result. A saved settings file records the thresholds used for that run.

Book text, search databases, downloaded models, and user query histories remain local. The public repository contains code and original demonstration text. Store private exports under the ignored data directory. Check exact staged filenames before publishing. An ignored folder is a convenience, not a guarantee: explicitly forcing a file into Git can still publish it. Never send private passages to a remote inference service.

Keyword retrieval ranks passages that share words with the question. Dense retrieval embeds the question and passages and compares their vector directions. Neither score is a probability of correctness. Reciprocal rank fusion combines the two ranked lists without pretending their numerical scores have the same scale. Compare both methods using reviewed questions and relevant passages, and inspect individual failures before changing the method.

Supply retrieved passages to the language model with numbered citations. The model should say when the passages do not support an answer. Validate that returned citation numbers were actually supplied. This catches nonexistent sources, but does not prove that a cited passage supports every claim. Read the supporting text and evaluate unsupported answers separately from retrieval success.

Split related records together before fitting features or models. Revisions of the same weather bulletin belong to one split. For transaction sequences, training uses earlier periods and evaluation uses later periods. For citation graphs, edges from after the prediction date must not enter the training graph. A randomly shuffled split can leak relationships that would not have been available at prediction time.

A mask marks which source pixels an edit may change. Preview coordinates must be mapped back to original image coordinates using the same scale and crop transform. Use procedural frames with known landmarks to check that mapping. Measure differences outside the allowed region after rendering; a correctly drawn preview alone does not demonstrate that the output obeyed the mask.

Connecting a pretrained model to a useful application demonstrates integration, retrieval, evaluation, and interface work. Training a model means changing learned parameters using training data. Fine-tuning adjusts a pretrained model for a specific task. Report those contributions accurately and identify the third-party model and weights. A working inference adapter is useful, but should not be presented as training a new language model.

Record a source URL, retrieval date, version, checksum, and reuse terms for each dataset snapshot. Open access to a page does not by itself establish permission to redistribute its full text. Code and data may use different licenses. A public example should use original text or a source whose terms clearly permit the planned use. Preserve required attribution when publishing derived material.
